category_title: Adult students with high statistics anxiety and low math self-efficacy
scenario_title: Writing statistical conclusions in collaborative lab
minimal_context: The student is working in a weekly three-hour lab session to write out statistical findings and conclusions for a summary report based on a business scenario.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to write out the statistical findings and conclusions for the summary report based on the business scenario data.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm really glad we are doing this in teams. I would have probably chosen to work with a partner just to have the security of having another brain or another’s thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think we should write for the first finding?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I had a hard time with that part. Usually, my partner helped me understand what the numbers actually mean.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep trying to write it down on your own first.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I just can't write out the statistical verbiage and conclusions by myself. Honestly, without a collaborative partner, I would have been totally lost from day one.
